payoutAddressNote: READ THIS BEFORE BELIEVING THE PAYOUT COLUMN. Every payoutAddress below is a STAND-IN, not a real operator address. No indexer or protocol team has opted into this system — every source is marked consent: pending, and none of them has given us an address. The addresses are deliberately derived from the public Hardhat/Anvil test mnemonic ('test test test test test test test test test test test junk', addressIndex 0..5) so that they are self-evidently not ours and not privileged: anyone can derive the keys, and anyone can call claim() as a source to check the payee path works. What is being demonstrated is the CONTRACT - that a paid read splits revenue across the deployments that answered it, withholds a slashable portion, and can refund a buyer out of it. The recipient list is not a claim that these teams are being paid. Note that a payoutAddress is keyed by DEPLOYMENT: the same deployment id appearing in two families is one sourceId onchain (keccak256 of the id string) and must therefore carry the same address.
note: Adding a protocol to a family is a change to THIS FILE ONLY. No code changes. A family is defined by a schema IPFS hash, which makes conformance an objective fact drawn from The Graph's own network subgraph rather than a label we assert: two deployments speak the same schema if and only if their schemaIpfsHash values are byte-identical. Deployment ids are pinned, and a response whose _meta.deployment does not match its pinned id is dropped, not merged. Discover sources with `npm run discover -- --schema <hash> --network mainnet --live`, then verify with `npm run registry:doctor`.

aave-v3-ethereum.label: Aave V3 Ethereum — independent deployment agreement
aave-v3-ethereum.comparabilityNote: Every source here indexes the same protocol on the same chain with the same schema, so they should agree exactly. Disagreement beyond the tolerance is not variance — it means at least one source is wrong, and the read is refused.
aave-v3-ethereum.query: query PMMarkets($first: Int!) { _meta { deployment hasIndexingErrors block { number hash timestamp } } markets(first: $first, orderBy: totalValueLockedUSD, orderDirection: desc) { id name inputToken { symbol decimals } totalValueLockedUSD totalDepositBalanceUSD totalBorrowBalanceUSD rates { side type rate } } }

lending-v1-ethereum.label: Standardized lending markets on Ethereum — cross-protocol survey
lending-v1-ethereum.comparabilityNote: These are different lending protocols that happen to speak one standardized schema. They are NOT expected to agree — a USDC supply rate legitimately differs between Aave and Spark. Spread is information about the market, not evidence of a fault, so no agreement check is applied. Read the per-source values, not just the median.
lending-v1-ethereum.query: query PMMarkets($first: Int!) { _meta { deployment hasIndexingErrors block { number hash timestamp } } markets(first: $first, orderBy: totalValueLockedUSD, orderDirection: desc) { id name inputToken { symbol decimals } totalValueLockedUSD totalDepositBalanceUSD totalBorrowBalanceUSD rates { side type rate } } }
